notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Bugs:
[list]
[*] Fixed: An issue where the game would freeze if you were pumping certain skills.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an informative control layout to the loading screen.
[/list]
[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: New Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies now have armor that reduces incoming damage by 35%.
[*] Added German language.
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Bosses have increased the damage of ranged attacks from 20 to 50.
[*] Increased spawn rate of enemies on maps.
[/list]
[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor bugs fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: A bug where some achievements did not work when conditions were met. 
[*] Fixed: A bug where the third boss did not appear on all maps.
[*] Fixed: Corrected inconsistency of characters characteristics with their real values.
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the amount of money dropped out of enemies.
[*] Reduced dropout rate of boxes of ammo.
[*] Increased the number of rounds that can be lifted from the ammo boxes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added automatic weapon reloading. This feature is enabled by default, but it can be disabled in the settings.
[/list]
[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed drone damage from (10/25/35/45/60) to (30/50/70/90/110)
[*] Now, with each puncture of the enemy, the damage from the projectile is reduced by 10%
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Game crashes when updating a certain skill.
[*] Fixed: Corrected localization.
[/list]

[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed values for the "Speed of Movement" talent.
[*] Changed the algorithm for calculating the "Speed of movement" talent.
[/list]
